headline: Book Donation Saved Pennsylvania Library—Now Thriving 15 Years Later
meta_description: A 2011 book donation of 6,000 volumes helped a struggling Pennsylvania library survive. Today it circulates nearly 200,000 items annually.
summary_short: In 2011, a major book donation kept a Pennsylvania library afloat. Fifteen years later, the library is thriving with record circulation and community engagement.
body:
In 2011, Taylor Swift donated 6,000 books worth $68,000 to a Pennsylvania library facing closure. The gift proved transformative for an institution on the edge of financial collapse.

Fifteen years after that donation, the library's impact tells a clear story of recovery and growth. Last year alone, it circulated 182,228 items and drew 27,452 program participants—evidence that the initial investment helped anchor the library as a vital community resource.

The donation arrived at a critical moment, when the library's survival seemed uncertain. What began as an act of generosity became the foundation for a thriving public institution, demonstrating how strategic support can restore essential services that serve thousands of people year after year.
